summary: Iteration 5 verification of the 4 session fixes: heat-overlay clusters_source, watchdog manage_external toggle, token_alert notify config, and code review of notifications/token-spike/model-failure paths. Backend pytest 5/5 pass (heatmap has clusters_source='model' + bins list; watchdog/status.settings.manage_external present as bool; POST /api/autotrade/watchdog/config without admin token -> 401; admin-token toggle ON returns settings.manage_external=true, IMMEDIATE reset OFF returns false, verified via a fresh GET). Frontend UI all 3 target flows pass (Playwright on preview URL): (1) [data-testid=chart-heat-toggle] click reveals [data-testid=chart-heat-legend] with content 'Schätzung (Hebel + OI + Volumen) · 15m' (source=model, as expected since Force-Order buffer is still filling – both 'echte Liquidationen (4h)' and 'Schätzung' are valid outputs); (2) After localStorage admin_token + reload -> settings-button -> tab-control -> [data-testid=watchdog-manage-external-toggle] visible; checkbox click ON (checked=true, toast 'Watchdog verwaltet externe Positionen jetzt aktiv') then OFF (checked=false, toast 'Externe Positionen werden nur beobachtet, nicht angefasst') – end state MUST be false and is verified false via API GET /api/autotrade/watchdog/status after the UI actions; (3) tab-telegram shows 'Token-Kosten-Wächter (ungewöhnlich hoher Verbrauch einer KI-Rolle)' as toggle row with checkbox (NOT changed). No AI generation was triggered, no telegram push initiated, no configs mutated except manage_external which is now false again (dual-verified).
critical_code_review_comments: services/notifications.py::notify_model_failure – correct: respects website_ai_failure toggle, dedupe_key includes provider/model/reason so identical repeated failures share a 15min cooldown, role label falls back cleanly to raw role or 'unbekannte Rolle', detail truncated to 120 chars.

services/notifications.py::notify_token_spike – correct dedupe via `web:token:{role}:{day}` and `tg:token:{role}:{day}` guarantees max 1x per role per Berlin-day, cooldown 1440 min. baseline==0 branch avoids ZeroDivisionError and phrases 'noch keine Vergleichstage'. _de_num uses German thousands separator ('.').

services/ai_providers.py::record_result – on status != 'ok' schedules notify_model_failure via asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task; bare except in the outer try is intentional (no running loop in sync test contexts). Note: use of the private `_current_role` at top of record_result is fine for the request-scoped role.

services/ai_engine.py::_check_token_alert – logic is correct: today >= TOKEN_ALERT_MIN (120k) AND (baseline == 0 OR today >= baseline * TOKEN_ALERT_FACTOR (2.5)); baseline is the 7-day average of prior days only ({'date': {'$lt': day}}). _track_tokens wraps _check_token_alert in try/except so a notify failure never aborts the analysis. Est-token math (len(prompt)+len(system)+len(text))//4 is a rough approximation (matches estimate_tokens' 3-char rule of thumb within ~15%).
routers/autotrade.py::set_watchdog_config – Depends(require_admin) enforced, returns settings dict; anonymous POST correctly rejected (verified with 401 in pytest).

Minor nit (non-blocking): notifications._last_sent is a module-level dict that grows monotonically; keys include timestamp-relative info like `web:token:{role}:{YYYY-MM-DD}` so old entries accumulate. Not a leak in practice (small keyspace, ~20 roles x days) but a periodic prune would be tidier.
